justifications.durability: Both new cases are red at the base (gate-base-reproduction.log, 2 failed, EXIT=1, FileNotFoundError naming the deleted worktree) and under the declared mutation (negative-control.log, 2 failed, EXIT=1), and test_a_reclaimed_run_cites_through_its_repository asserts an independent refusal ("does not resolve") rather than echoing the value it passed in.
